about: NisCorp AI is a software and AI engineering company. We build practical AI (RAG, agents), modern web apps, and operations software on proven stacks—then hand over systems your team can run.
processAssurance: We complete the agreed scope, document what we deliver, and hand it over cleanly—then stay available for support and future improvements on your terms.

processSections.heading: Discover the work
paragraphs: A short call to understand goals, users, and constraints.

processSections.heading: Scope & proposal
paragraphs: Plain-language scope, timeline, and acceptance criteria. You know exactly what will be delivered.

processSections.heading: Build in sprints
paragraphs: Weekly demos and feedback. We ship working software incrementally.

processSections.heading: Launch & handover
paragraphs: Production deploy, docs, and a handover so your team can run it. You keep the code and credentials.

processSections.heading: Stabilize & support
paragraphs: 30-day stabilization window for fixes. Optional care plan for enhancements, monitoring, and small improvements—cancel anytime.

Data & Search: OpenSearch vector search, Snowflake, data modeling, analytics, D3.js

Quality: Agile delivery, code reviews, TDD with Jest/NUnit, release discipline
